newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soymeal seen down $1 to $2 on follow through.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soymeal seen down $1 to $2 on follow through.

text.p: CBOT soymeal futures were expected to open $1.00 to $2.00 per ton lower on follow-through selling after limit losses in July delivery Wednesday.
Soyoil futures were expected to open 0.05 to 0.10 cent per lb lower, mostly on spillover weakness from soybean futures, traders said.
Soybeans are expected to open down three to five cents on weak old-crop export data.
Wednesday, talk of Brazilian soy imports pushed July soymeal down its daily limit of $10.00, so more selling is seen on the open, traders said.
